scope: Medusa 2.7.0 payment module and PostgreSQL, controlled PayPal SDK transport

rules.contract: An authorized payment with no capture must have no active capture rows, null captured_at and zero collection captured_amount.
One completed full capture must correspond to one active capture of the same amount, captured_at and a completed collection with the same captured_amount.

A pending capture must not establish completed merchant capture: captured_at must remain null and collection must not be completed or count pending money as captured. An active Medusa Capture row has no pending status and contributes to captured_amount, so it cannot represent an unresolved attempt safely in this module.
A definitive capture rejection with no provider capture must leave no active capture rows, null captured_at and zero collection captured_amount.
Provider order, authorization and capture identities, payment/session/collection relationships, and exact USD major-unit amounts must agree with the run contract.

limitations: No settlement, concurrency, retries or duplicate-charge guarantee
Pending eventual completion remains untested independently of the current-state safety rule
